sermon.title: Jesus Revealed—September 19, 2021
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: A younger speaker follows Jesus’ example of expounding Himself from the Old Testament, using Samson in Judges 14: the Philistine woman pictures God’s love for all people, the torn lion pictures Jesus overcoming Satan with the word, the honey is sweet freedom, and the wife’s pressing shows how to press into God through prayer, fasting, worship and the word.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: The message begins at 35:36 after worship. He says “I think Samuel wrote this book” of Judges.

chunks.short_answer: The church and people; Samson wanted her, as God so loved the world He gave His Son.

God so loved the world that he gave his only begotten son so here we see Jesus Christ he so loved the world he loved the Gentiles he loved the Jews he is looking at everyone and he’s saying I want these people.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Now Samson went down to Timnah, and saw a woman in Timnah of the daughters of the Philistines. So he went up and told his father and mother, saying, “I have seen a woman in Timnah of the daughters of the Philistines; now therefore, get her for me as a wife.” Then his father and mother said to him, “Is there no woman among the daughters of your brethren, or among all my people, that you must go and get a wife from the uncircumcised Philistines?” And Samson said to his father, “Get her for me, for she pleases me well.”
For God so loved the world that He gave His only begotten Son, that whoever believes in Him should not perish but have everlasting life.
